view.en: Third-person 3D: the camera follows behind the active character. The boss name, status line and health bar are at the top; a side panel shows the four party members (health, energy ring, skill cooldown); the active character's health and stamina are below, with skill and burst rings, the timer and the lock-on state.

goal.en: Empty the boss's health bar to win; you lose when the whole party is down; each fight lasts at most 300 seconds and a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate by itself; only the healer's abilities or healing effects restore it.

mouse.en: The mouse turns the camera, but only while lock-on is off. The fight opens with the camera unlocked (free camera); press R to lock onto the target. In this game dx > 0 turns the view RIGHT and dx < 0 turns it left; dy > 0 lowers the aim pitch, which only affects unlocked bow aiming.

keys.en: move forward relative to the camera
move left relative to the camera
move backward relative to the camera
move right relative to the camera
dash: brief invulnerability on press; holding runs and drains stamina
normal attack, hold to chain; pressed in the air it is a plunge attack
hold to charge a heavy attack; the archer taps for one arrow and fully charges for a fire arrow
elemental skill; the archer can hold it to set the decoy throw distance
elemental burst; needs full energy and no cooldown
swap to the previous living character
swap to the next living character
toggle target lock-on; off at the start

notes.en: You control a party of four, one active at a time: swordsman (sword, ice), archer (bow, fire), spearman (polearm, fire) and healer (catalyst, water). Q / E swap, with a shared cooldown of about 1 s; fallen characters are skipped.
Each character has their own skill (K) and burst (L) with separate cooldowns and energy; energy builds from normal attacks and skills. Skill names are not shown; read the cooldown and energy rings.
Ice is useless against the wolf and some elements do nothing to the cube, so swap by scene: bosses and water creatures have different weak elements.
Elemental reactions: hitting a target with different elements in turn triggers reactions (overload, superconduct, vaporize, melt, freeze and so on) for bonus damage or effects.
Stamina is shared by the whole party; dashing, sprinting and swimming drain it, and without stamina you cannot dash.
J, LMB and the archer's K work while held; E, Q, R, L, Shift, Space and the other characters' K take effect on a press.
Archer: unlocked, holding LMB gives an over-the-shoulder aim and arrows follow the crosshair, able to hit the colossus's eye and back weak points. Locked, arrows aim at the target automatically.
When locked the camera and facing follow the target and strafing does not turn the camera; when unlocked you steer the camera with the mouse.

action.en: Attack, skill and dodge for the active character

options.attack: hold J for normal attack chain
options.charge: hold LMB to charge a heavy attack
options.charge_release: hold LMB for 3 sub-steps then release
options.shot: tap LMB: one arrow, or a normal attack
options.shot_up: tap LMB and raise aim ~5 degrees
options.shot_down: tap LMB and lower aim ~5 degrees

options.lock_left_18: toggle lock and turn left 18 degrees

summary.en: A floating cube boss that alternates between a closed shell and an exposed core, in a flat arena.

tell.en: The cube raises a block fist and winds up for about 0.7 s

effect.en: Lunges forward with a punch that damages on hit

counter.en: Sidestep or dash through

tell.en: Two plates swing open, then snap shut after about 0.9 s

counter.en: Back out of the fan or circle behind

tell.en: The body morphs in turn into scissors, fist and palm shapes

effect.en: Each shape has a different reach, hit in a row

counter.en: Read the current shape: scissors are narrow and long, palm is widest; keep moving

tell.en: Spins into a spiral and charges up for about 0.8 s

effect.en: Charges at speed in a straight line

counter.en: Dodge perpendicular to the line

tell.en: Four beam ports light up, then rotate for several seconds after about 1 s

effect.en: Rotating beams sweep the floor and hurt on contact

counter.en: Jump or dash through the gaps between beams

tell.en: A ring of diamond crystals floats up, then fires after about 1 s

effect.en: Projectiles fly at your position and explode

counter.en: Keep strafing and leave your spot before the blasts

tell.en: Eight light pillars rise around the edge, warning for about 1.6 s

effect.en: Pillars link into a lasting energy net that traps you

counter.en: Stay in the safe zone inside; do not touch the pillars

tell.en: The boss drops down and rings start to spread on the ground

effect.en: Spreading rings that hurt along the ground

counter.en: Jump with Space as a ring reaches you

tell.en: Three crystal blocks are left after the shell closes

effect.en: The blocks carry shields and keep the boss protected until broken

counter.en: Use a character or element that counters them; break the blocks, then hit the exposed core

phases.en: The boss is mostly closed and cannot be damaged; the core is exposed only after certain moves. Burst it then.
One kind of element does nothing to this boss, so swap characters.

summary.en: A large mechanical colossus with weak points on the eye and back; its body is tough.

tell.en: Lifts one foot, then stomps after about 0.6 s

effect.en: Small circular quake around the foot

counter.en: Move away from the foot or dash out

tell.en: Raises an arm, then slams forward after about 0.5 s

counter.en: Sidestep

tell.en: Two punches, then a leap and landing

effect.en: Two punches followed by a wide landing slam

counter.en: Back away or dash and avoid the landing point

tell.en: Crouches and spins, then marches while spinning after about 0.7 s

effect.en: Repeatedly hits nearby targets while spinning

counter.en: Keep a good distance

tell.en: Back cannons swivel and open; six missiles in about 2 s

counter.en: Run in circles so they miss; hit the back weak point to interrupt

phases.en: Two quick aimed hits on the eye or back weak point paralyse it; burst then.
Its body strongly resists physical damage; use elemental damage.

summary.en: A 3x3 platform in a pond. The boss itself cannot be hit; defeat the water creatures it summons.

tell.en: Water swells and forms animal shapes in about 1 s

effect.en: Five waves; each kind has a different weak element and some heal, explode or fly

counter.en: Swap to the character that counters the element; kill healers first

tell.en: Some platforms bubble and begin sinking, warning for about 1.7 s

effect.en: Sunken tiles become deep water; swimming drains stamina

counter.en: Jump to a tile that is still above water

tell.en: If the fight drags on, a whirlpool forms on the water

effect.en: The whirlpool follows you and hurts on contact

counter.en: Keep moving and clear the wave fast

phases.en: There are five waves; platforms sink after waves 2 and 4 are cleared.
Use the archer's arrows against flying or in-water targets.

summary.en: A fast melee boss. Attacks from far away are deflected by the mask, so you must close in.

tell.en: Raises a blade, then slashes three times after about 0.4 s

effect.en: Each slash lunges a little, frontal fan

counter.en: Back off or sidestep; close in during the gaps

tell.en: Crouches, then dashes in a line after about 0.6 s

effect.en: Line damage with another blade strike at the end

counter.en: Dodge perpendicular to the line

tell.en: Raises the blade for about 1 s while air pulls inward

effect.en: Pulls you in, then sweeps in a circle

counter.en: Dash through, or keep distance during the wind-up

tell.en: Throws a mask forward after about 0.5 s

effect.en: Mask flies in a straight line and hurts

counter.en: Move sideways

tell.en: A mask lands and detonates after about 1.4 s

counter.en: Leave the mask area before it explodes

tell.en: The boss stands still for about 2 s

counter.en: Close in and attack

tell.en: Five short hops in a row

counter.en: Keep chasing it

tell.en: Slams the ground after about 1.2 s; invulnerable then

counter.en: Get away or prepare to jump before it lands

tell.en: Plants both blades in the ground after about 1 s

counter.en: Keep distance

tell.en: Clone adds a delayed slash after the main body's

effect.en: Two waves of attacks offset in time

counter.en: The second wave arrives slightly later; dodge again

tell.en: Main body winds up while a clone adds an outer sweep

counter.en: Evade the inner ring, then the outer

tell.en: Clones fire three blades one after another

counter.en: Strafe

phases.en: At around 70% health the boss turns invulnerable and changes phase; clone and dual-blade moves appear.
From a distance, all your attacks are deflected by the mask.

summary.en: A huge tundra wolf in a round arena, immune to ice and wind; phase 2 starts around half health.

tell.en: Lifts a paw, swipes forward after about 0.4 s

counter.en: Sidestep

tell.en: Crouches, then leaps onto your position after about 0.7 s

effect.en: Circular damage at the landing point

counter.en: Leave the landing spot while it is airborne

tell.en: Backs up and winds up for about 0.9 s

effect.en: Charges in a line leaving a trail

counter.en: Run perpendicular

tell.en: Turns and flicks 5 ice spikes that explode a few seconds later

counter.en: Leave the spikes before they pop

tell.en: Swings its tail when you are close

counter.en: Back off or dash through

tell.en: Spins, then releases an ice ring after about 0.9 s

counter.en: Get outside the circle or dash

tell.en: At about half health it leaves and runs around the arena

effect.en: Cannot be targeted; leads to phase 2

counter.en: Keep distance and wait

tell.en: Howls up; ice falls in 3 waves after about 1.1 s

counter.en: Leave each circle as it appears

tell.en: Roars, then the whole arena hurts for a while after about 1 s

effect.en: Continuous damage across the arena and detonates ice pillars

counter.en: Hide behind an ice pillar or dash

tell.en: Raises a paw, then fires 3 fan air slashes after about 0.6 s

counter.en: Step into the gaps or move to the side

tell.en: Ice lines appear on the ground, a wave moves along them after about 0.8 s

counter.en: Leave the line

tell.en: At low health it howls and calls small wolves

counter.en: Clear the wolves first or keep dodging while hitting the boss

phases.en: Immune to ice and wind, so the swordsman is nearly useless; use fire and other elements.
Around half health there is an arena-run interlude, then phase 2 adds ice pillars and more moves.
Fire melts ice pillars; roars or air slashes detonate them.

summary.en: A two-phase caster that fights with ice first, then fire. There are beacons at the four corners and a temperature gauge on screen.

tell.en: Raises a hand, fires a spread of ice shards after about 0.5 s

counter.en: Dodge to the side

tell.en: A circle shows on the ground; ice falls after about 0.7 s

counter.en: Step out of the circle

tell.en: Three frost blooms appear and explode after about 1.5 s

counter.en: Stay away from all three

tell.en: Fires 5 homing ice spears in sequence

counter.en: Run in circles so they cannot turn

tell.en: At close range she gathers ice and bursts after about 0.7 s

counter.en: Back off

tell.en: An ice array forms under you, warning for about 1.3 s

counter.en: Leave during the warning

tell.en: Hurls a giant spear that stays in the ground and explodes after about 4 s

counter.en: Get away before it blows

tell.en: At low health she is encased in an ice shell while flames float around

effect.en: The shell has a large shield and normal damage fails

counter.en: Pick up a floating flame and hit the shell with it

tell.en: A fire whip appears, swings after about 0.4 s

counter.en: Back off or sidestep

tell.en: The whip straightens and thrusts after about 0.5 s

counter.en: Dodge sideways

tell.en: Three fire whips lash out in different directions and then pop

counter.en: Stand in the gap between whips

tell.en: Her form turns to fire and rushes at you

counter.en: Dash away

tell.en: A fireball forms and launches after about 0.5 s

effect.en: A slow fireball that keeps going

counter.en: Walk or jump away

tell.en: Markers appear in the sky; fire pillars fall in 3 waves after about 0.8 s

counter.en: Leave each wave's circles at once

tell.en: Releases 6 floating flames at once

counter.en: Strafe so they miss

tell.en: A slow homing flame

effect.en: Follows you for a long time

counter.en: Walk around it

tell.en: A fire whirl patrols the arena and sheds small flames

counter.en: Keep moving and avoid its path

tell.en: When she is hit hard in some states she retaliates

counter.en: Do not burst her down all at once; shoot from outside its range

phases.en: The temperature gauge is the arena clock: you bleed when it is full; use the beacons (ice lamps and fire braziers) to adjust it.
At about 20% health she is covered in an ice shell; you need to pick up a floating flame to break it.
Phase 2 uses fire moves and resists fire strongly.
